title: Neuroprotective Effects of Rhodiola Sacra on Transient Global Cerebral Ischemia Through Activating AMPK/Nrf2 Pathway in Rats.
authors: Li, Kongping; Jiang, Jiaqi; Shi, Zhe; Zhan, Lixuan; Peng, Linhui; Sun, Weiwen; Tang, Yanyan; Zuo, Xialin; Xu, En
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红景天通过AMPK/Nrf2通路对大鼠脑缺血神经保护作用，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aims: Rhodiola sacra is a widely used pharmaceutical component with multiple functions, including anti-oxidation and anti-inflammation. However, the exact mechanisms involved in neuroprotection against transient global cerebral ischemia (tGCI) remain to be elucidated. Herein, we aim at closing the gap in understanding on whether rhodiola sacra reduces neuronal death in hippocampal CA1 and at demonstrating how rhodiola sacra offers neuroprotection after tGCI. Results: The results show that rhodiola sacra (2.4 g/kg/d by feeding) pretreatment or/and postreatment significantly alleviated neuronal injury, inhibited glial activation, and improved cognitive function in male rats subjected to tGCI. The neuroprotection of prophylaxis with rhodiola sacra is equivalent to that of therapeutics. The binding mode of adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK) alpha2-subunit with rhodiola sacra was predicted by molecular docking. Further, rhodiola sacra upregulates phosphorylated AMPK and promotes nuclear translocation of nuclear factor erythroid 2 related factor 2 (Nrf2). In addition, rhodiola sacra increases heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) expression and activity and reduces malondialdehyde (MDA) content in CA1 after tGCI. However, the neuroprotection of rhodiola sacra is abolished by Nrf2 knockdown with small interfering RNA (siRNA) after tGCI. Similarly, the inhibition of AMPK with Compound C or siRNA against AMPK alpha2 aggravates neuronal death after tGCI through decreasing nuclear Nrf2 and the expression and activity of HO-1, and by increasing the release of MDA. Innovation and Conclusion: For the first time, this study demonstrates that as a prophylactic or therapeutic agent rhodiola sacra prevents oxidant stress, protects neurons, and improves cognitive function through activating the AMPK/Nrf2 pathway in tGCI rats. Antioxid. Redox Signal. 36, 567-591.
abstract_zh: 目的：红景天（Rhodiola sacra）是一种广泛使用的药用成分，具有多种功能，包括抗氧化和抗炎。然而，其在短暂性全脑缺血（tGCI）中提供神经保护的确切机制仍有待阐明。本研究旨在填补关于红景天是否减少海马CA1区神经元死亡以及其如何在tGCI后提供神经保护的理解空白。结果：结果表明，红景天（通过喂养给予2.4 g/kg/d）预处理和/或后处理显著减轻了雄性大鼠在tGCI后的神经元损伤，抑制了胶质细胞活化，并改善了认知功能。红景天预防性用药的神经保护作用与治疗性用药相当。通过分子对接预测了腺苷一磷酸活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）α2亚基与红景天的结合模式。此外，红景天上调磷酸化AMPK，并促进核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）的核转位。另外，红景天在tGCI后增加CA1区血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）的表达和活性，并降低丙二醛（MDA）含量。然而，在tGCI后通过小干扰RNA（siRNA）敲低Nrf2会消除红景天的神经保护作用。同样，使用Compound C或针对AMPKα2的siRNA抑制AMPK，通过减少核内Nrf2以及HO-1的表达和活性，并增加MDA的释放，加重tGCI后的神经元死亡。创新与结论：本研究首次证明，红景天作为预防或治疗药物，通过激活AMPK/Nrf2通路，在tGCI大鼠中防止氧化应激、保护神经元并改善认知功能。抗氧化与氧化还原信号 36, 567-591。
